title: International checkout support
description:
As the platform team, we need checkout to support additional markets, languages, and currencies, so that international expansion is not blocked by checkout.
Checkout is English-only, EUR-only, and offers cards and PayPal only. The shop already ships to several EU markets; checkout has not followed the international expansion. Sales wants five additional markets live this year. Support reports non-English tickets already take days to resolve. Finance has no position on display currencies and FX pricing. There is no single owner for international checkout.
Scope is not defined: markets, languages, currencies, and local payment methods are all open.
acceptance_criteria: International customer reaches checkout → checkout is usable for them.
Prices displayed in a non-EUR market → correct for that market.
International order placed → can be fulfilled like a domestic one.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
